# 1. main figures
```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(circlize)
library(stringr)
library(dendextend)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(scales)
library(ggsci)

```


## pathogenic bacteria
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
asv_table <- read.csv("bac_pathogen_abundance.csv", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
meta <- read.csv("bac_metadata_paired.csv", row.names = 1)

common_samples <- intersect(colnames(asv_table), rownames(meta))
asv_table <- asv_table[, common_samples]
meta <- meta[common_samples, ]

# === pla_unique ===
bulk_samples <- rownames(meta)[meta$Habitat == "environment"]
pla_samples  <- rownames(meta)[meta$Habitat == "plastisphere"]

pla_unique <- apply(asv_table, 1, function(x){
  all(x[bulk_samples] == 0) & any(x[pla_samples] > 0)})

pla_unique <- as.integer(pla_unique) 

# === PNP ===
asv_norm <- asv_table / rowSums(asv_table)
weights <- ifelse(meta$Habitat == "plastisphere", 1, -1)
names(weights) <- rownames(meta)

PNP <- apply(asv_norm, 1, function(x){
  sum(x * weights[colnames(asv_norm)])})

result <- data.frame(
  ASV_ID = rownames(asv_table),
  pla_unique = pla_unique,
  PNP = PNP)

#write.csv(result, "bac_patho_attribute.csv", row.names = FALSE)

da <- read.csv("bac_patho_attribute2.csv") 
da$group <- factor(da$group, levels = c("Animal", "Plant", "Zoonotic"))
counts <- table(da$group)

type_count <- as.data.frame(counts)
type_count$min <- 0


type_count <- type_count[, c("Var1", "min", "Freq")]
type_color <- c("#F59B7B", "#A4DDD3", "#ABD7EC","#FCC41E")  

```



```{r}
pla_unique <- da[, c("group", "Start", "End", "pla_unique")]
pla_unique <-list(pla_unique[pla_unique$pla_unique=="1",])
PNP <- da[, c("group", "Start", "End", "PNP")]

PNP <- list(PNP[PNP$PNP>0, ],
                     PNP[PNP$PNP<0, ])

```


```{r}
circos.clear()
pdf(str_c('patho_bac_circoplot.pdf'), width = 8, height = 8)
circle_size = unit(1, 'snpc')

circos.par(track.height = 0, cell.padding = c(0,0,0,0), track.margin = c(0.015,0.015), gap.degree = 0, start.degree = 90)

circos.genomicInitialize(type_count, plotType = NULL, major.by = 1) 

circos.track(
    ylim = c(0, 1), track.height = 0.03, bg.border = NA, bg.col = type_color, 
    panel.fun = function(x, y) {
        ylim = get.cell.meta.data('ycenter') 
        xlim = get.cell.meta.data('xcenter')
        sector.name = get.cell.meta.data('sector.index')  
        circos.text(xlim, ylim, sector.name, cex = 0.5, niceFacing = FALSE)  
    } )

## pla_unique
circos.genomicTrackPlotRegion(pla_unique, track.height = 0.05,ylim = c(0,2), 
                              bg.border = "#3D4F6A", 
                              bg.col=NA,
                              panel.fun = function(region, value, ...){
                                i=getI(...)
                                if(i == 1){
                       circos.genomicRect(region, value, col = "#EB7E60", border =NA)}
                                else{
                       circos.genomicRect(region, value, col = "#ABD7EC", border = NA)
                                }
                                })

#relative_PNP
circos.genomicTrackPlotRegion(PNP, track.height = 0.3, bg.border = "#3D4F6A", bg.col = NA,
                              ylim=c(-1,1),
                              panel.fun = function(region, value, ...){
                               i=getI(...)
                                if(i == 1){
                                  circos.genomicRect(region, value, col =  "#EFB04B", border = NA, alpha = 1, ybottom = 0, ytop.column = 1)
                                }else{
                                  circos.genomicRect(region, value, col = "#7B9DBB", border = NA,alpha = 1, ybottom = 0, ytop.column = 1)
                                }})
dev.off()

```

# 2. sector figures
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
```

## 2.1.1 PNPM for patho bacteria
```{r}
data <- read.csv("bac_patho_attribute2.csv")
data_summary <- data %>%
  group_by(group, PNP_attribute) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  mutate(percentage = count / sum(count))

p2.1.1 <- ggplot(data_summary, aes(x = "", y = percentage, 
                               fill = factor(PNP_attribute))) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1, color = "black") +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  facet_wrap(~ group) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#7B9DBB", "#EFB04B")) + 
  labs(fill = "PNP_attribute",
       title = "Proportion of plastisphere enriched taxa by Group",
       y = "Proportion",
       x = "") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        panel.grid = element_blank())

p2.1.1

ggsave(plot = p2.1.1, "patho_bac_PNPM_proportion.pdf", width = 180, height = 160, units = "mm")

```


## 2.1.2 Pla-unique for patho bacteria
```{r}
data_pnpm <- data %>%
  filter(PNP_attribute == "PNPM")

data_summary_pnpm <- data_pnpm %>%
  group_by(group, pla_unique) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  mutate(percentage = count / sum(count))

p2.1.2 <- ggplot(data_summary_pnpm, aes(x = "", y = percentage,
                                        fill = factor(pla_unique))) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1, color = "black") +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  facet_wrap(~ group) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("white", "#EB7E60")) + 
  labs(fill = "Plastisphere Unique",
       title = "Proportion of plastisphere_unique in PNPM by Group",
       y = "Proportion",
       x = "") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        panel.grid = element_blank())

p2.1.2

ggsave(plot = p2.1.2, "patho_bac_pla_unique_proportion.pdf", width = 180, height = 160, units = "mm")

```
